G6 criterion (max abs error below 0.01 pu on the benign envelope): **pass** (max 0.00707 pu).

## Worst case found by search, and the error bounds used by the robust exact layer

Differential evolution maximising the max abs linear-minus-AC error over benign states, 500 power flows per topology and quantity (one joint DE over all radial configurations with 40 x that budget). delta = 1.25 x max(sample max, worst found); saved to `rules/model_error_bounds_sherlock.json`. delta is an empirical bound, not a proof.
